# Case intake implementation

The workshop case record must keep the case ID, the requester's description, and any missing detail visible. Prefer explicit C# types and a small deterministic check over a model call for this exercise. Build with `dotnet build Customization.csproj` and run at least one complete and one incomplete input. Report the exact checks performed.
